title: UpdateColumn
description: Update Column API request to update individual column metadata such as display name, description, tags, and glossary terms, addressed by the column's fully qualified name. This API works for the inline children of table, dashboardDataModel, topic, container, mlmodel, pipeline, searchIndex, apiEndpoint and worksheet. The displayName, description and tags fields apply to every type; constraint and removeConstraint apply to table only; extension applies to table and dashboardDataModel only.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this column name.

tags.description: Tags and glossary terms associated with the column. Use source: 'Classification' for classification tags and source: 'Glossary' for glossary terms. Provide an empty array to remove all tags. Note: Invalid or non-existent tags/glossary terms will result in a 404 error.

constraint.description: Column level constraint. Only applicable to table columns, ignored for dashboard data model columns, rejected with 400 for every other entity type.

removeConstraint.description: Set to true to remove the existing column constraint. Only applicable to table columns, ignored for dashboard data model columns, rejected with 400 for every other entity type. If both 'constraint' and 'removeConstraint' are provided, 'removeConstraint' takes precedence.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the column. Supported for table and dashboard data model columns only, rejected with 400 for every other entity type.
